metadata.command_line: /tmp/repo/experiments/eval_rs_uep.py --checkpoint /kaggle/input/datasets/vaishakprasadbhat/rs-uep-jscc-models/kn_1_12/best_val.pth --oracle_ranking_file /kaggle/input/datasets/vaishakprasadbhat/rs-uep-jscc-models/kn_1_12/oracle_ranking.json --data_dir ./data --split test --importance oracle,energy --schemes three_tier_25_25_50,three_tier_25_50_25,two_tier_25_75,two_tier_50_50 --seeds 0,1,2,3,4 --include_no_rs --workers 4 --device cpu --output_dir results/phase3/kn_1_12/test_sweep --name test_sweep --wandb --wandb_project rs-uep-jscc --wandb_name kaggle-eval-kn_1_12

evaluation.side_info_rule: 0 B for uniform/no_rs, one byte per channel for sorted methods
evaluation.mask_protocol: one master mask per (batch, seed, rate) shared by all methods; smaller schemes use its first columns

insights: Based on 5 channel seed(s); 10000 images per seed. All gains below are paired per seed against the baseline (same packet losses), so they carry no luck-of-the-draw advantage.
Break-even: the best protected method overtakes `uniform` from about erasure_rate = 0.35.

Low-loss penalty: even the best method is 1.50 dB below `uniform` at erasure_rate = 0.3 (two_tier_50_50@energy). This is the block-length effect of a single large RS block, which tiered coding gives up.
Peak gain: +1.98 dB at erasure_rate = 0.45 by three_tier_25_50_25@oracle (95% CI ±0.08, significant).
Importance sources ranked by their best scheme's mean gain over erasure_rate >= 0.35: oracle +1.28 dB, energy +1.12 dB.
Share of the reference ranking's gain captured: energy 87%. A share above 100% means that source allocated protection better than the reference.
Worst-case images at erasure_rate = 0.4: 5th-percentile PSNR 15.52 dB (three_tier_25_50_25@oracle) vs 14.08 dB (uniform).
Worst-case images at erasure_rate = 0.5: 5th-percentile PSNR 13.48 dB (three_tier_25_25_50@oracle) vs 13.06 dB (uniform).
Seed sensitivity: std across channel seeds stays below 0.3 dB everywhere.
`uniform` shows its steepest fall (-3.48 dB) between erasure_rate = 0.35 and 0.4 -- its cliff.
